2609.05258.title: Ask Before You Optimize: Dynamic Pre-Formulation Clarification for Interactive Optimization
2609.05258.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to formulate optimization models from natural-language problem descriptions, yet realistic operations research (OR) requests are often incomplete: missing objectives, constraints, or business rules can change the resulting mathematical program. Existing evaluations largely assume a complete specification and therefore overlook whether an agent knows when clarification is needed before modeling. We introduce OR-Clarify, a benchmark for pre-formulation clarification. Each task presents a partial public problem description, withholds structured hidden slots, and evaluates agents through bounded interaction with a simulated user. The benchmark supports both openended and choice-based clarification, and measures slot recovery, stopping behavior, silent assumptions, and interaction cost. We further propose Interactive Optimization (InterOPT), a two-stage framework that identifies unresolved formulation-critical gaps and uses them to guide whether to ask the next question or to stop. In our choice-based experiments, InterOPT substantially outperforms all baselines in exact slot recovery; in the open-ended setting, it remains competitive with strong prior methods. Together, OR-Clarify and InterOPT reframe OR assistance as a selective completeness decision: clarify when needed, stop when ready, and quantify what remains missing.
2609.05258.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）越來越多地被用來從自然語言問題描述中制定優化模型，但現實中的運籌學（OR）請求往往是不完整的：缺少目標、約束或商業規則可能會改變最終的數學程序。現有的評估大多假設完整的規範，因此忽略了代理是否知道在建模之前何時需要澄清。我們介紹了OR-Clarify，一個用於預先制定澄清的基準。每個任務提供一個部分公開的問題描述，隱藏結構化的隱藏槽位，並通過與模擬用戶的有限互動來評估代理。該基準支持開放式和基於選擇的澄清，並測量槽位恢復、停止行為、默認假設和互動成本。我們進一步提出了互動優化（InterOPT），這是一個兩階段框架，用於識別未解決的關鍵性制定缺口，並利用這些缺口來指導是否提出下一個問題或停止。在我們的基於選擇的實驗中，InterOPT在準確槽位恢復方面大幅超越了所有基準；在開放式設置中，它仍然與強大的先前方法保持競爭力。OR-Clarify和InterOPT共同將OR輔助重新構架為一個選擇性完整性決策：在需要時澄清，準備好時停止，並量化剩餘的缺失。
